svg.title: Tritone (A4/d5): information sheet, phone layout
svg.desc: Tritone, A4/d5: C4 to F♯4 = G♭4, 6 semitones. A keyboard from C4 to C5 with both keys highlighted in this interval's identity colour and 6 numbered semitone hops. Two time strips show the notes one after another and together. Plogger [6] lens: Perfect-group family (straight), ↔ Both (midpoint), Neutral (Plogger), midtone dotted.

g.text: 4 letter names counted inclusively (C to F)

How to read: find C4 on your keyboard, then
count 6 semitones up (every key, white or
black, is one step) to F♯4. The numbered
arcs are those steps. Top left shows the two
